summary: Practise GROW conversations, SMART goals and mentoring agreements. Explore the five-day foundation course and its workplace exercises.
lede: Coaching and mentoring training helps people who guide colleagues plan and conduct focused development conversations. For team leaders, HR and learning practitioners, and experienced specialists, it covers distinguishing coaching from mentoring, using GROW questions and SMART goals, and giving SBI feedback. You will practise agreeing role boundaries, setting actions and review points, and keeping follow-up records while leaving responsibility for learning with the colleague.
audienceIntro: The course is designed for people who support colleagues’ learning through regular work conversations, role guidance or development planning.
prerequisites: This foundation course assumes no prior knowledge of coaching models. Experience in a workplace role that involves supporting or developing colleagues will help you apply the exercises. No coding or specialist software is required; the digital mentoring check-in workflow is a paper-based, conceptual design exercise.
